[[File:Sadain.jpg|thumb|the leaders of the Borokii ride their sadain mounts]]
'''Sadains''' were domesticated riding animals used by the nomadic [[Alwari]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Each sadain had a single nostril, four legs, a stocky body, four eyes, a round face, and long, flaring ears.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
